# PaperPhicons fixtures

- `<case>/`: reference exports from the Processing version (`print.pdf`, `fold.svg`,
  `calib.svg` under fixed names; Processing names them `result_`, `res_f_`, `calib_f_` plus a
  timestamp) and `params.json`. Generated by `node scripts/fixtures/paperphicons/generate.mjs`
  from `scripts/fixtures/paperphicons/cases.json`. Do not edit by hand.
- `aruco1024_px.png`: the marker sheet PaperPhicons reads its markers from, copied unchanged
  from `PaperPhicons/aruco1024_px.png`. 32 × 32 markers of 8 × 8 px: black border, 5 × 5 data
  cells, black border, one white spacer column/row.
